card.name: Partway through drug names and numbers
card.fires_on: Inside long drug names such as divalproex, sofosbuvir and benzodiazepines, and on the first digit of dose or time numbers. It also fires on small words like "are" or "is" in the middle of a phrase about two things being linked or compatible.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Middle pieces of long generic drug names, or the word extended before -release.

modes.label: Inside numbers
modes.description: The first digit of a dose or time number, with more digits to follow.

modes.label: Linking verbs
modes.description: Small verbs or pronouns in clauses about two things being linked or compatible with each other.
modes.example: another drug with which it<< is>> not pharmaceutically compatible

card.writes: It suppresses Chinese words meaning between or with each other, so it adds no clear output effect beyond that.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of long drug names and dose numbers, where the word or number is not yet finished.
